parts.text: I keep our drones and charging equipment in working order by adding new drones to the fleet, retiring old ones, and setting up charging pads at our sites. I take drones out of service for repairs and put them back, and I send drones to charge. We run a few hundred drones of several models from different manufacturers, which differ in payload, flight range, sensors, and charging connectors. Our repairs and servicing are carried out by technicians, and regulators can ask us to show how our drones have been looked after.
